answer: A payout is split and as a result 45% arrives at settlement and the rest over 5 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The horizon schedule is applied in quill and anchor reveals each instalment. An adversary hence cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2169 identities would post 1367 proofs and burn roughly 64 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
